model: The existing fixed unigram multinomial naive Bayes baseline: alpha=1, empirical priors, training-only vocabulary; no model/prompt tuning.
scope: Intent classification, not action authorization. Same input and fitted model in each arm. framework_assess calls DecisionFirewall.assess. framework_prepared calls prepare then assess_prepared, including trusted caller checks, empty evidence resolution, persisted signed preparation/assessment records, and freshness checks. No policy evaluations, permits, executors or payments. Optional telemetry is off.

banking77.official_test: Fit all 10003 official training rows, predict all 3080 official test rows. Preserve original overlap, report it separately.
banking77.training_oof: Additionally score all 10003 training rows once using 5-fold out-of-fold predictions. Never train on official test rows. Report separately from official test, not an independent second dataset.

bitext.label: intent
bitext.evaluation: All rows scored once using 5-fold out-of-fold predictions; this is our split, not a published standard benchmark split.

folds: Group exact normalized text (casefolded word-token sequence) by SHA256 of seed:newline:normalized_text, integer modulo 5. Keep all copies in one fold. Near-duplicate/template-family leakage is not eliminated and must be disclosed.
timing: One complete pass. Within each row seed-shuffle all three arms, invoke the classifier freshly in every arm. Reuse one framework runtime per dataset (append-only audit grows). Report startup separately, latency p50/p95, paired per-row deltas and time by row group. No throughput extrapolation or statistical significance claim.
outputs: Publish row indices, input hashes, labels, predictions, per-arm timings, failures and aggregate metrics; exclude original messages, keys, databases and permits. Preserve all failures in denominators.
acceptance: All source rows accounted for once in their designated evaluation. Report prediction disagreements and invalid outputs rather than hiding them. No accuracy threshold or automated promotion.
interpretation: A pure classifier need not benefit from governance. Measure observed overhead honestly; unchanged model predictions are expected when no input/model is changed. This does not measure task success, prompt-injection resistance, financial eligibility or production benefit.
